owner: TechX (suggested; any team may pick up this story)

acs.text_first_line: A partner file on an open instruction is recorded and announced
The attach outcome closes the submission
A held file is copied to the partner side and attached by no one here
The same file under the same instruction writes one submission
A submission that cannot be accepted writes nothing
A refused record leaves no trace
The submission and its attach state read on SCR-35

ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/partner/v1/partner/instructions/{instructionId}/documents: multipart file and documentType in, PartnerSubmission out (201), Partner portal C on the own firm, Idempotency-Key required, errors 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 503
GET /api/recovery/partner/v1/partner/instructions/{instructionId}/documents: query state, page, size; SubmissionPage out, Partner portal R on the own firm, errors 401, 403, 404, 503
ops_consumed: rwb-document intake creation (RWB-P5-E1032-CON carries the IntakeItem shape; the operation itself is not published, CG-B2-S9-017-5) for the file reference, the partner source and the case ID of the instruction
rwb-document item read GET /api/recovery/document/v1/intake-items/{intakeItemId} (RWB-P5-E1032-CON) for the match state and the candidate cases of an open submission
rwb-case parameters read (RWB-P3-E1042-CON behind the client library, DP-06) for the intake bound
rwb-case reference-data read (RWB-P3-E1043-CON behind the client library, DP-07) for LOV-DOC-TYPE and LOV-INSTR-STATUS
events_published: rwb.partner.PartnerDocumentSubmitted.v1 on rwb.partner.events.v1, key caseId: submission ID, instruction ID, case ID, document type, file SHA-256, intake item ID, submitted time; outbox in the acceptance transaction (DP-09)
events_consumed: rwb.document.DocumentAttached.v1 on rwb.document.events.v1 (owner P5 rwb-document, RWB-P5-E1032-APP 12.3): closes the submission with the document ID and signals documentAttached
workflows: PartnerInstructionWorkflow on rwb-partner: signal documentAttached (submission ID, document ID)
PartnerIntakeReconcileWorkflow on rwb-partner with the activities recordPartnerDocument and reconcilePartnerIntake
Schedule partner-intake-reconcile, every 15 minutes in business hours (the legacy JOB-12 cadence)
